_doc: Placement tiers that auto-place a crash without GPS (locate.Gate). A tier is added only by a user decision (docs/03): exact (>= 98% Wilson 95% lower bound on hidden-truth tests); unique_pair (user 2026-10-22, #211 evidence: at or above exact on hidden police GPS and LAPD open data). Street pairs that meet in more than one place still go to review.
